title: Lynx notices
description: The notices shown in the Physiome Links applications.

schema.description: The layout of this file. Applications read only the layouts they know, so it changes only when an older application could no longer read the file.

application.description: The applications that read this file, by the name each looks for in a notice's targets.

date.description: A day (2026-11-12, taken as the start of that day in UTC) or a moment (2026-11-12T09:00:00Z).

id.description: What an application remembers a read notice by: unique, and never changed or used again.

description.description: Plain text; line breaks are kept, markup is shown as written.

link.description: Where to read more, such as an issue. Applications follow https links only.

severity.description: How pressing the notice is; info when left out.

published.description: When the notice is first shown. Notices are listed newest first.

expires.description: When the notice stops being shown. Give one to anything that will not matter for ever.

targets.description: The applications that show the notice: all, or any of the applications.

versions.description: By application, the versions of it that show the notice, as a semver range such as <0.8.0. An application left out shows the notice in every version.
